text:
maya: DeployBot alert: lease renewal failures on migration mig_4677 during tenant-shard repartition at 02:13 UTC. Possible hot-row.
DeployBot: [deploybot] LEASE_FAIL_WARN mig_4677 shard=shard-09 inflight=22/28 renewals_failed=3
nick: hitting this now. If we keep going leases will drop and rollback will be messy. Can we do an immediate selective pause for the affected tenant range?
olga: selective pause + small backfill window is best. We shouldn't pause whole migration. Praveen, can runtime grab prefix cache snapshot?
praveen: runtime can snapshot KV for the tenant range. cost ~40s. I'll start it if we agree.
maya: decision: selective pause for tenants 1001-1100, snapshot KV, then probe extend 20s. If renew fails again -> escalate rollback.
nick: executing selective pause: ```deploybot pause mig_4677 --tenant-range 1001-1100 --actor nick --reason "lease renew failures"```
DeployBot: [deploybot] SELECTIVE_PAUSE_ACK mig_4677 tenants=1001-1100 by nick at 1794440020
praveen: starting KV snapshot hook now. tag run in runbook https://confluence.redwood/internal/runbooks/migrations#mig_4677
DeployBot: snapshot_status mig_4677 tenants=1001-1100 status=done checksum=sha256:3a7f
olga: checksum good. inflight dropped to 8. ready for extend probe.
nick: running extend probe 20s: ```deploybot extend mig_4677 --secs 20 --actor nick```
DeployBot: EXTEND_FAIL mig_4677 reason="renewal timeout" at 1794440048
maya: extend failed. We have two options: 1) try handoff to standby worker (cross-AZ) 2) full rollback for those tenants. Handoff may cause 1-2s latency spike but avoids rollback. Thoughts?
praveen: standby in same region has historically succeeded on these spikes. Handoff preferred.
 olga: +1 handoff. pick worker-standby-2. make sure to pin migration tool to infra/mig-v1.13.2 so we don't get different behavior across owners.
nick: initiating handoff: ```deploybot handoff mig_4677 --to worker-standby-2 --tenant-range 1001-1100 --actor nick```
DeployBot: [deploybot] HANDOFF_START mig_4677 -> worker-standby-2 tenants=1001-1100 at 1794440055
DeployBot: HANDOFF_OK mig_4677 new_owner=worker-standby-2 latency_spike=1.8s
maya: handoff success. resuming tenants at 15% rate. ratecap cmd issued.
DeployBot: RATECAP_SET mig_4677 tenants=1001-1100 fraction=0.15 at 1794440060
ReleaseBot: [releasebot] NOTE_PINNED mig_4677 note="selective pause, KV snapshot, handoff to standby-2, pinned infra/mig-v1.13.2" by olga
praveen: monitoring locks and backpressure; will trigger rollback script if inflight >20 or lease failures resume.
maya: leaving postmortem stub and tagging owners. Close thread after 20m stable. If rollback happens, open full incident and notify account teams.
